name: Why is waterproofing so critical during a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Why is waterproofing so critical during a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper waterproofing is critical because water intrusion behind tile can rot subflooring, degrade framing, and cause hidden mold growth. Standard drywall and standard grout are not waterproof on their own. Quality remodeling involves installing dedicated waterproofing membranes or sealed backer board panels behind shower surrounds and under floor tile. Shower pans require a watertight pre-slope and flood testing before setting tile. Prioritizing robust waterproofing during rough construction prevents costly structural repairs and premature bathroom teardowns down the road.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterproofing membranes behind tile prevent water leaks, hidden mold growth, and structural rot that can ruin subfloors and framing over time.
